name: בּוּז
summary: Buz son of Nahor and brother of Uz (Gen 22:21), and Buz of the tribe of Gad, father of Jahdo (1Ch 5:14). The name has the same spelling as בּוּז, contempt, but scripture does not state the name's meaning.

evidence.note: The shared spelling בּוּז is used for contempt.

note: The place Buz in Jer 25:23 is not a person and is not included in people.
